scripts.api:check: pnpm run api:generate && git ls-files --error-unmatch packages/api-contract/openapi.json packages/api-contract/src/schema.d.ts && git diff --exit-code -- packages/api-contract/openapi.json packages/api-contract/src/schema.d.ts
scripts.api:generate: pnpm run api:openapi && pnpm exec prettier --write packages/api-contract/openapi.json && pnpm --filter @industry-platform/api-contract run generate
scripts.api:openapi: uv run --locked --package industry-platform-backend python -m industry_platform.openapi --output packages/api-contract/openapi.json
scripts.eval:sec-tool: uv run --locked --package industry-platform-backend python -m industry_platform.modules.disclosures.tool_eval --dataset evals/scenarios/sec-tool-v1.json --observations evals/observations/sec-tool-v1.json --json-output evals/reports/sec-tool-v1.json --markdown-output evals/reports/sec-tool-v1.md && prettier --write evals/reports/sec-tool-v1.json evals/reports/sec-tool-v1.md
scripts.eval:release-contract: uv run --locked --package industry-platform-backend python -m industry_platform.modules.evaluation.release --registry evals/registry/sec-agent-datasets-v1.json --manifest evals/manifests/sec-agent-release-v1.json --registry-schema-output evals/schemas/dataset-registry-v1.schema.json --manifest-schema-output evals/schemas/release-eval-manifest-v1.schema.json && prettier --write evals/registry/sec-agent-datasets-v1.json evals/manifests/sec-agent-release-v1.json evals/schemas/dataset-registry-v1.schema.json evals/schemas/release-eval-manifest-v1.schema.json
scripts.eval:fixed-context-adapters: uv run --locked --package industry-platform-backend python -m industry_platform.modules.evaluation.materialize --registry evals/registry/sec-agent-datasets-v1.json --root .data/evals --report-directory evals/reports && prettier --write evals/reports/finqa-adapter-v1.json evals/reports/finqa-adapter-v1.md evals/reports/tatqa-adapter-v1.json evals/reports/tatqa-adapter-v1.md
